verse-atlas

First-party Tiinex Atlas Verse — scalable spatial exploration and visualization of Universe, Workspace, lineage and artifact relationships over the shared Tiinex application data plane.

Grounding boundary:
- Start from `.topics/.workspaces/tiinex-verse-atlas.workspace.md` and the Workspace fresh-start Reduction under `.topics/reductions/workspace/`.
- Historical refactor/viewer execution lineage is reduced; no prior Task is current. Future Atlas work starts from a new explicit bounded Task with truthful Project ancestry.
- Presentation must consume qualified shared semantics rather than infer domain truth from repository/path layout.
